note: off macOS the aggregate is empty without spawning
an empty profile: tools/wine and tools/proton are created, nothing is listed
every tools/wine entry is listed with lib/lib32 (here lib64 and lib) and wineserver only where present
the lib64 folder absent: lib is "" and lib32 is the ../lib folder
the Lutris runners directory under the home directory is read after tools/wine
proton directories need a proton file; UMU-Latest* is skipped; readdir order decides the order
libraries from libraryfolders.vdf (a missing one is filtered): compatibilitytools.d only, as showValveProton is off
showValveProton adds steam/steamapps/common and steamapps/common for each library
libraryfolders.vdf absent: only the fixed /usr/share/steam library is considered
a failing Rust read of libraryfolders.vdf falls back to /usr/share/steam only
wine on PATH is listed last-but-custom, named by the first line of --version
a failing --version keeps the binary name
custom paths last: a path ending in proton is Custom Proton (no wineserver), others are Custom Wine with wineserver beside them
with no config file (a new installation) the custom paths are skipped
scanCustom false: the custom paths are not read even when the config exists
the config exists and lists no custom paths
result order: proton (tools, then Steam libraries), tools/wine, Lutris, system wine, custom
